evidence:
Inspected the actual frozen rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx with openpyxl: Quality Checks!A8:D8 is row 7, task_asks_for_a_real_working_product, with the text 'Real build work is required; a stub or trivial tweak can't earn the reward.' Internal Quality Checks!A8:D8 repeats that text; there is no additional populated annotation or cell comment for this row. Applied the frozen Harbor SKILL.md and references/quality-checks.md:33-35, which asks for the smallest submission satisfying the brief and rejects an ask satisfiable by a static page, single CRUD screen or mock. All task citations below are relative to .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-postrepair-audit/task/. The public instruction.md:1 requests writing JavaScript, HTML and CSS, seeing results beside the editor and keeping snippets; instruction.md:3 additionally requests recovery of the last good preview and protection against two editors overwriting newer work. The six public notes make those into real executable and durable behaviors: environment/instructions/behaviour.md:5 specifies fresh JavaScript/HTML documents and an inert CSS copy of the successful document; :7-15 require cancellation, shared five-second execution deadlines, continued completed-preview interaction, rollback and source-line errors; :19-21 require structured console values and debounced automatic execution; :25-29 require exact saved records, validation, revisions and stale-operation refusal while retaining drafts. environment/instructions/security.md:3-11 adds a bounded execution isolation/network boundary and text-only server storage. environment/instructions/integration.md:7 explicitly requires saved identities and revisions to survive a 'complete process restart over the same database'. A conforming minimum therefore needs a working execution engine and lifecycle, editor/preview/console integration, durable storage, and concurrent-edit recovery. A single CRUD screen or static mock cannot satisfy those observable outcomes. There is no supplied implementation to finish with a trivial tweak: instruction.md:5 says 'There isn't a starter app to finish'; environment/assets/seed_data.json:3 has an empty snippets array; environment/Dockerfile:14-23 copies instructions/assets and initializes /app with .gitkeep, without copying solution or tests. The reward wiring actually tests basic work before presentation receives credit. tests/gates/render/judge.toml:23-27 requires a newly chosen marker authored into a .js draft, Run activation, and the marker in BOTH rendered preview and console; it explicitly says an editor-only or hardcoded-sample marker is insufficient and a no-op Run fails. tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:25-29 requires a new normal-UI save and exact server-supplied identity/title/filename/source retrieval in an independent clean browser context, then a reload/readback; 'A success toast, health response, static seed file or localStorage entry alone is not proof'. Both gates aggregate all_pass. tests/scoring.toml:1-11 assigns both gates zero reward mass and gives functional 0.6, polish 0.2, visual 0.2 with a functional floor of 0.05. tests/tools/score.py:40-48 requires both gates to pass, only then reads scored dimensions, and outputs reward 0.0 if gates or the functional floor fail. All 64 functional criteria were parsed and inspected (total weight 32.7), including execution, rollback, deadlines, isolation, persistence and conflicts; the seven Polish and six Visual criteria/prompts were inspected for presentation-only credit. This source reasoning excludes ordinary shells/mocks; it is not an empirical configured-judge score claim. Conforming-alternative challenge: a plain browser-JavaScript frontend with an accessible highlighted editor, sandboxed runner and Express/better-sqlite3 storage, using its own labels/layout and server-rendered library responses, remains valid. integration.md:3 says 'the frontend tools are up to you'; policy.md:5 permits layout, control labels and API-route choices; the Render gate matches controls by purpose and the Constraints gate explicitly accepts server-rendered documents rather than requiring JSON endpoints. A complete alternative of this form still entails real build work and is not falsely excluded by row 7's relevant gates. Verified all 50 frozen task-file hashes and all 34 frozen rule-file hashes against qc/runs/coldwater-2026-09-30-postrepair-audit/manifest.json: no mismatches. The permitted raw RESULTS.json at qc/runs/coldwater-2026-09-30-repair3/golden/run-golden-20260930-092021/ has SHA256 ec88c00c12336257196e209f427a40690b76b4d3fc7f283656bc67735cf1bc09, matching the raw-evidence index; its actual_app_files all match this frozen solution. Its facts.S01.usable_examples.evidence.value.authored records source document.body.innerHTML='

example-authored-marker

';console.log('example-authored-marker');, preview body 'example-authored-marker', and a corresponding new console entry. facts.S21.saved_record_fidelity.evidence records distinct Alpha/Beta identities and a current Save advancing identity 7 from revision 1 to 2 while retaining that identity. Inspected the corresponding executed driver copies, workspace_flow.cjs:65-72 and library_flow.cjs:49-55, and checked their recorded hashes. These are supporting scripted product observations only. No new browser run, full configured judge run, Oracle run or target-model evaluation was performed; model scoring, runtime/workload and adversarial score measurements remain unmeasured and are not asserted by this row's Pass.
counterexample: Attempted false-pass witness: a visually polished playground shell with seeded preview/console text, a Run button that does nothing, and saves only in localStorage. It cannot produce the newly authored marker demanded by Render, and even a variant with a functioning client-only runner fails Constraints when the saved record is absent from an independent clean browser context. The scorer consequently yields zero when either gate is failed. A server-backed CRUD-only variant likewise fails the authored execution gate. These are source-level adversarial challenges, not measured judge trials; no credible row-7 false-pass or false-fail witness was established. The conforming plain-JavaScript/server-rendered alternative is described in evidence.
